scripts.push-update: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const msg = process.argv[1] || 'update'; execSync('git add .', {stdio:'inherit'}); execSync(`git commit -m \"${msg}\"`, {stdio:'inherit'}); execSync('git push origin main', {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.push-update-help: echo Example: npm run push-update -- "fix firebase production"
